question_text: A foreign investor from Japan wants to buy a 10-hectare agricultural land in Davao to establish a rice plantation. Under Article XII of the 1987 Philippine Constitution, which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: The investor may buy the land outright because the Constitution allows foreign ownership of agricultural land for agricultural purposes.
The investor may buy the land only if he partners with a Filipino citizen who owns at least 60% of the enterprise.
The investor cannot own the land because the Constitution reserves land ownership to Filipino citizens, except in cases of hereditary succession.
The investor may lease the land for a period of 50 years, renewable for another 25 years, but cannot own it.
